name: consec_air_a_hop_poke_counts_only_once_the_ball_is_above_150
description: The car drives at 1400 uu/s toward a ball resting on the floor at (-1000, 0, 93) and hops at decision step 8 with boost held, so it is a few tens of uu off the ground when it pushes the ball (touch frames 10-14, car z 57-116, measured). The push lifts the ball: ball z is 112, 133, 151, 166, 178 on frames 10-14. Before the 2026-11-03 ball floor all five contact steps counted (a chain of 5: peak +0.8564 = +34.3 weighted). Now a touch counts only with the ball above 150 uu (strict), so frames 10 and 11 do not count and the chain starts on frame 12 (ball z 151): frame 12 is the lone first touch (0), frame 13 pays gamma*Phi(2) = 0.39225 (+15.7), frame 14 brings the sum to 0.62894 (+25.2). RESIDUAL (finding): the car's own poke lifts the ball over the floor and the contact that follows still counts at full value; the floor shortens a hop-poke chain from 5 to 3 but does not remove it, because the credit does not scale with how far above 150 the ball is (AerialTouch's own payment does: ballFrac = (z - 150) / 1300). The car keeps boosting and stays airborne, so there is no landing refund inside the 45 frames shown.

expect.intent: the hopping car pushes the ball on frames 10-14
the two contact steps with the ball under 150 uu (frames 10, 11) and the lone first counted touch (frame 12) pay nothing
frame 13 is the second counted touch: gamma * Phi(2) = 0.39225
frame 14 is the third: cumulative 0.62894 (it was 0.8564 after five touches before the floor)
